title: Review and fix UI library foundation implementation plan
description: Review the phase 1 implementation plan against the revised design and current Flutter APIs. Fix code examples, gallery behavior, validation commands, boundaries and repository workflow instructions. Change the plan only; do not implement phase 1.

title: Revise database shell design after review
description: Resolve save and finalization semantics, shutdown guards, stale and uncertain outcomes, employment setup and retained actions, domain-backed mockup fields, keyboard conflicts, phase dependencies, and text-scaling acceptance criteria. Update the design and reference artifacts without implementing the shell.
notes: Revised the design with a per-object save matrix, finalization/repricing confirmation, parent/child pending edits, native-close/File Quit guards, all six MutationOutcome states, Work setup/action destinations, precise picker key rules, phase-4 production cutover and scaling acceptance tests. Corrected the HTML reference and regenerated its 1280x800 PNG. Updated all five implementation-phase descriptions and acceptance criteria. Validation: JavaScript syntax; Chrome rendering with EraSans, no runtime errors and all four subforms; section/reference/whitespace checks; PNG dimensions; visual inspection. Production code unchanged.
close_reason: Review findings resolved in design and reference artifacts; five implementation phases synchronized and remain open.

title: Phase 5: clean-up and DESIGN.md
description: Remove unreachable old shell, task pane, address bar, desks, saved views, Journal, Properties/form dialogs and tests specific to deleted components. Apply the forward-only migration dropping only desk, desk-tile and saved-view tables. Finish obsolete DESIGN.md references and compare the final layout with the corrected reference. Behavior-test and golden migration occurs with phase 4 cutover, not deferred to this cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Unreachable old shell, task pane, address bar, desks, saved views, Journal, Properties/form dialogs and their tests deleted; Drift migration drops only desk, desk-tile and saved-view tables with migration and schema checks passing; obsolete DESIGN.md references removed; final 1280x800 and scaling matrix verified against the corrected mockup.

title: Phase 3: new shell and edit session (harness)
description: Integrate AppFrame, EditSession and WorkEditAdapter with Shifts in a new-shell integration harness. Implement the section 4.2 save matrix, parent/child pending edits, planned-day identities, guarded finalization and repricing, all mutation outcomes, native-close/File Quit guards and route handling. Include employment/agreement setup for empty-database harness flows. Keep the current production shell until phase 4.
acceptance_criteria: AppFrame + WorkEditAdapter run Shifts end to end in the new-shell integration harness: planned-day vs stored-record selection, parent/child edits, guarded finalization, repricing, validation, every MutationOutcome, single-flight saves, close guards, route round trips, inline employment/agreement setup from an empty DB. Production shell unchanged.

title: Phase 4: Work sheets and production cutover
description: Connect every retained workflow in section 4.9: Work/Employment overview and setup; all Work sheets; schedule Cycle/Preview and versioning; day actions; agreement correction/change-terms/end; period review/reopen; payslip entry/correction. Verify all workflows in the new-shell harness, then perform one production cutover to AppFrame. Update app-level integration tests, affected goldens and DESIGN.md in the same phase. No runtime shell flag or temporary loss of retained workflows.
acceptance_criteria: All section 4.9 workflows run inline and are covered; single production cutover to AppFrame; app-level tests and goldens migrated alongside (no disabled tests, no bulk-accepted goldens); old shell unreachable; DESIGN.md interaction/layout rules and library links updated.

title: Phase 1: UI library foundation
description: Move era widgets into lib/ui behind ui.dart, add CATALOG.md, a gallery-only temporary host using existing controls, the app.sh entry, guard tests, lifeos-ui skill and project pointers. The host must not depend on phase 2 widgets or open the production database. See revised design sections 5 and 7.
acceptance_criteria: Every era widget under lib/ui behind ui.dart; CATALOG.md covers each; gallery opens from ./app.sh via its temporary host (synthetic fixtures, never the production DB); guard tests pass; lifeos-ui skill, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md lines and bd remember pointer exist; production pixel-identical (existing goldens unchanged); ./app.sh 1-3 green.
notes:
Phase 1 progress (uncommitted, working tree on feat/work-schedules-screens): T1 specs test ignores assets/; T2 workbench -> lib/ui (git mv, 42 files); T3 ui.dart barrel + import guards; T4 PropertySheetTabs/EtchedLine split; T5 gallery host + startup_mode (LIFEOS_GALLERY=1) + app.sh option 5; T6-7 44 demos, coverage guard, 44+44 goldens, 200% demo test; T8 CATALOG.md + guard. Full suite 1097 pass, analyze clean, test/goldens unchanged.
T9: lifeos-ui skill (.claude + .agents mirror + openai.yaml), pointer lines in CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/DESIGN.md, bd remember lifeos-ui-library; test/repository green.
T10: app.sh 2 (1099 pass) and 3 (analyze/format/schema clean) green; option 1 release app starts and looks unchanged, quit normally; LIFEOS_GALLERY=1 selector test + boundary green; option 5 gallery opens (title, 44 grouped demos, knobs), quit normally. Hands-on demo clicking left to the owner.
close_reason: lib/ui library, ui.dart barrel, CATALOG.md, gallery, guards and lifeos-ui skill in place; production goldens unchanged; final review fixes applied (1104 tests pass)

title: Phase 2: data widgets
description: Build section 6 widgets, including ConfirmWindow and LicencesPage, with catalog entries, gallery demos and goldens. Replace the temporary gallery host with AppFrame, TreeView and PropertyGrid. Apply section 4.6 at the new editor hosts while preserving existing production callers until cutover. See revised design sections 3, 4.6, 5, 6, 7 and 10.
acceptance_criteria: Section 6 widgets with synthetic and real-font goldens; tests for the editor-only keyboard contract (4.6), mouse selection, pick mode, virtualisation and scaling; gallery runs on AppFrame/TreeView/PropertyGrid and the temporary host is removed; production shell unchanged.

title: Database shell and UI library
description: Rearrange LifeOS as a 2001-era database front end (area tabs, object tree, editable data grid + subform, property column, inline action panels) and establish lib/ui as the one UI library with CATALOG.md, gallery and lifeos-ui skill. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-08-database-shell-and-ui-library-design.md

title: Date picker freezes and jumps months
description: Owner: the era date picker 'straight up freezes / jumps months'. Reproduce in the real hosting forms, find the cause, fix.
notes: 2026-10-08 owner: still broken in date boxes in forms (not the Work calendar). Symptoms: ◂/▸ skips months, calendar won't respond, wrong date picked, closed box misbehaves. Everywhere: agreement form, shift/day forms, schedule editor, toolbar/periods. Touch-kind tests never reproduced it.
close_reason: Root cause (real mouse via uinput): on KDE Plasma Wayland + NVIDIA the window presents a frame only when the next is drawn; one-frame changes stayed invisible. Fixed with a trailing frame on Linux (93a8df5).

title: Type dates into era date boxes
description: Owner wants keyboard date entry as an option: digits into the selected part (year/month/day) like the time box.

title: Correct a typo in an agreement in use
description: Owner: can't fix a typo in an in-use agreement; the form says to use Change terms from a date (+1). Ruling: Properties edit all fields in place; label/note save directly; pay-affecting changes ask for confirmation showing repriced finished shifts/leave (count, EUR before→after, reviewed periods). Change terms from… stays for real changes. Record the correction in history.

title: Days before any pay agreement read 'No pay agreement'
description: Planned days no agreement covers can't be confirmed (Invalid agreement), so the calendar/Shifts list never update for months before the agreement. Owner chose: show 'No pay agreement' (greyed), drop them from days-to-confirm counts, list them as unavailable in Confirm worked days with a link to set up / extend the agreement. Supersedes lifeManager-ejh.2.

title: Agreements cannot be updated or removed
description: Owner chose: change terms from a date (new version; past pay unchanged), move start earlier / end later in place even when in use, delete an unused agreement, end an agreement.

title: Planned shifts as rows in the Shifts list
description: Owner chose: the Shifts list shows planned (schedule) days in scope as greyed Planned rows next to recorded shifts; opening one opens the day's Properties. Never stored until confirmed.

title: Remove (void) a recorded shift without a replacement
description: No way to remove a shift. Owner chose: 'Remove this shift…' asks a reason and voids it (kept in history, out of totals); a day confirmed from the schedule returns to 'to confirm'.

title: Night shift continuation not shown on next calendar day
description: A shift ending the next day shows only on its start day; show a continuation entry on the next day's cell.

title: Calendar click lag
description: Calendar cell single click waits ~300ms (GestureDetector onTap+onDoubleTap). Select on pointer down, open on double-click; profile other lag.

title: Type digits into era time boxes
description: EraTimeField only steps with spin buttons/arrows; the owner must click number by number. Accept digits typed into the selected part (Win32 Date/Time Picker style), ':' to move on.

title: Night shift 19:30–07:30 refused unless +1 day ticked
description: Shift type dialog, DayTimesForm and the manual shift form refuse an end earlier than the start unless the owner ticks '+1 day' / 'Ends the next day' or picks the end date. An end at or before the start can only mean the next day (shifts are at most 24 h): derive it.

title: Work schedules part 2: screens
description: Build the work schedule screens from docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-work-schedules-design.md sections 5-6 (Calendar, day actions, Confirm worked days, Schedules view and editor, shift types, Leave view, shell integration). Part 1 (data, domain, pay) is done. First step: write the Part 2 implementation plan.
notes: Plan written: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-07-work-schedules-2-screens.md (13 tasks). Awaiting review and choice of execution approach.

title: UI library phase 1: deferred review minors
description: From the phase 1 final review (deferred, not blocking): (1) catalog guard should check names in the job table and Foundation list and end each entry body at the next ## heading; (2) dart_test.yaml real-font skip message names only test/goldens/real_font_check_test.dart; (3) CATALOG API lines show required enum params as if defaulted (Orb glyph/tone, OperationalState kind); (4) boundary test should forbid ui.dart exporting lib/ui/gallery and cover lib/core + lib/bootstrap.dart; (5) EraCombo demo reserves space for its list but its golden shows it closed; (6) data/shell demos not in the knob-combination test. Fold into the phase 2 plan.

title: Status bar, Books badge and desk tiles show 0 when days-to-confirm fails
description: shell_host.dart ~130 and desk_host.dart ~269 map an error from pastPlannedDaysProvider to 0/empty (spec §7: nothing silently does nothing). The Confirm dialog's row pay also comes from a second stream (planInputsProvider) and can read '—' for a frame during a widen.

title: Era scrollbar: deferred update may apply a stale metrics snapshot
description: era_scrollbar.dart defers a mid-layout update to post-frame (fix for 'Build scheduled during frame' on removing a shift); the snapshot is not checked for being newest; no unit test reproduces the crash.

title: Shifts list: a failed plan shows no planned rows silently
description: app_router.dart ~133 maps AsyncError of plannedShiftsProvider (and the schedules read ~114) to an empty list; spec §7 wants the failure worded. Also a brief flicker of planned rows while loading after a scope change.

title: Next shifts tile: use the app clock, refresh when a shift ends
description: desk_host passes DateTime.now() to nextShifts instead of the injectable clock (FixedClock), and the tile only recomputes on desk rebuild, so a shift ending at 19:00 stays listed until the next rebuild. Use the clock provider and schedule a refresh at the next shift end.

title: Schedules sheet: selection task group with Properties link
description: Selecting a schedule row adds no task group; DESIGN.md says the first task group follows the selection.

title: Schedule editor block count uses bare TextField
description: schedule_editor.dart block count is the only bare TextField (no visible label, not era styling); use EraField.

title: Leave Correct…: validate reason inside the dialog
description: leave_sheet.dart: Correct… with a blank reason closes the dialog and loses the chosen type and illness date. Validate in the dialog instead.

title: Schedule editor: honest delete and preview error words
description: schedule_editor.dart: a failed delete always says 'A confirmed day may use it.' even for storage failures; Preview reports any planning error as an unknown timezone. Word each outcome (spec §7).

title: Unguarded dirty listener lights Apply on focus in shift and agreement forms
description: shift_forms.dart and employment_agreement_forms.dart:333 mark the sheet dirty from a TextEditingController listener that fires on selection/focus, so Apply lights without an edit. The schedule screens fixed this for their own forms; apply the same guard.

title: Shift type rows: keyboard focus and selected semantics
description: Shift-type list rows in the schedule's Shift types dialog have no keyboard focus or selected semantics (Task 9 deferred minor).

title: Day cells: semantic open action for screen readers
description: Calendar cells only select on tap via semantics; screen-reader users cannot open a day. Add an open/activate semantics action (Task 3 deferred minor).

title: Show Unavailable on calendar days without an agreement
description: Spec 7: planner errors (no agreement on a date) show on the affected days as Unavailable with the reason in Working. Part 2 states it on the day's Properties only; the calendar cell says nothing.
close_reason: Superseded by lifeManager-uw7 (No pay agreement days)

title: Working explanation for a day's planned pay
description: Spec 6.2 asks for a Working group box for the selected pay figure on a day's Properties. Part 2 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-07-work-schedules-2-screens.md) shows planned pay only as a fact. Needs a planned-pay explanation beside work_explanations.dart.

title: Date trace prints 'Instance of Rect' in release
description: LIFEOS_TRACE_DATES anchor lines print Instance of 'Rect' in release builds (toString minified); format the rect fields explicitly.

title: Shifts sheet planning ~17 ms per reload on an open scope
description: Planned rows for the open-ended Shifts scope plan from the first schedule start to end of next month and price each day, re-running on every commit to six tables while the sheet is open. Memoise or narrow the window if it becomes noticeable.
